{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|Cuisine of India]] | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan Cuisine]]

This makes an excellent side dish, and goes well with a large variety of things, from spicy eggplant to tofu to potatoes in coconut sauce.

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive oil|olive oil]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Cashew|cashews]]
* 2 cups basmati [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* 4 cups [[Cookbook:Water|water]]

==Procedure==
# Heat the olive oil in a pot.
# Add the cumin, then the raisins and cashews. Sauté for two minutes.
# Add the rice, and sauté for another minute.
# Add water, and bring everything to a boil.
# Lower the heat, cover, and cook for 12 minutes.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Basmati rice is recommended, as other types may turn out poorly. Do not use Italian [[Cookbook:Risotto|risotto]] rice, or any sticky rice.
